lines: #Your comfort zone feels *safe.*
But it's the most *expensive* place you'll ever live.
It costs you the career you didn't *chase.*
The conversation you didn't *start.*
The person you never got to *become.*
Every year you stay there, the price goes *up.*
And one day, you look back and realise you paid it with *time.*
#Growth never happens where it's *comfortable.*
Muscles grow when they're *pushed.*
Skills grow when you're *bad* at something first.
Confidence grows when you do it *scared.*
Every person you admire was a *beginner* once.
They just didn't let the fear *decide.*
#So today, pick one thing that makes you *uncomfortable.*
Make the call. Send the message. Lift the heavier *weight.*
It won't feel *good.*
It's not supposed to.
Your heart will race. Your hands might *shake.*
Good. That means it *matters.*
Do it *anyway.*
#Discomfort is the price of a *bigger* life.
And it's always cheaper than *regret.*
Pay it *today.*
end: Follow for your daily push at 7am & 7pm.
